summary: Practise clearer decisions, inclusive meetings and reliable handoffs for global teams. Explore the five-day course and its practical outputs.
lede: Cross-cultural global leadership training helps team leads, project coordinators and managers coordinate culturally diverse teams through clear operating agreements. Participants map work expectations, clarify decision and task ownership, plan time-zone handoffs, structure asynchronous updates, facilitate inclusive meetings, and draft feedback and escalation protocols for shared work.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is for professionals who coordinate shared work across cultural expectations, languages, locations or time zones. It suits people who need practical agreements for decisions, communication and accountability in global teams.
modules: Global Team Mandate and Cultural Intelligence
Cultural Preferences and Clear Team Messages
Integrated Global Team Charter and Leadership Update
prerequisites: Prior experience coordinating or leading team work is useful. No specialist cultural-framework knowledge or coding is required.
